_about: TEST DATA (CP-37). Placeholder fixed questions until Javin's real list arrives. Replace this file with that list: same shape, site type to questions. Seeded once into checklist_fixed_items when it is empty.
Distribution warehouse: Is the fire pump and its controller in automatic mode?
Are all sprinkler control valves sealed or locked open?
Is storage kept clear of sprinkler heads by at least 0.5 m?
Cold store: What insulation panel type is used, and is its fire rating known?
Is the refrigerant type and its charge recorded?
Chemical plant: Are flammable liquids stored in rated cabinets or bunded areas?
Is there a process shutdown and isolation procedure?
Paper mill: Is dust build-up on beams and ducts cleaned on a schedule?
Port terminal: How is stacked container storage separated and accessed by fire services?
Data centre: Is a clean-agent or very early warning detection system fitted in the data halls?
Office: Are fire doors kept closed and not wedged open?
Shopping mall: Are tenant fit-outs checked against the sprinkler layout?
Mixed-use development: Is there fire separation between the different occupancies?
